description_en: 🌇LUXURY apartment for sale 3+1+2 📏 Total area 181 m2 Organized in: 🛋️Large living room + separate kitchen and dining room 🛏️3 bedrooms 🚻2 toilets Large laundry Large balcony Floor height 3.3 meters Investment inside the apartment includes: * Modern furniture of a very high quality standard * Floor and ceiling air conditioning system in one room (toshiba) * Doors and wall cladding in the corridor exceeds the value of 20k euro investment. * Plaster ceilings, LED lighting and spotlights. * ⁠extra electrical installations * ⁠parquet with a price of 45eur/m2. * There is a solar panel on the terrace of the building only for the apartment Building with ventilated facade With certificate of ownership 📍 It is located in Garden Residence Turdiu, a complex that includes all facilities, from playgrounds to flower gardens and promenades. 🤑Price €380,000
